owner_statements: That was not the intention - we need a key that will invariably work as "hold to talk" regardless of keyboard focus or activating voice mode.
Axctually, in that case the space key would still be more practical - when held down continuously, -> voice
selected_behavior: Tap Space retains ordinary native input; hold unmodified Space for 300ms invokes focus-independent player speech and release finalizes an editable draft without automatic Submit.
scope: Bounded Space gesture, Main input/UI integration, lifecycle fencing and necessary tests. No recognizer/model audition, OS-global hotkey, physical audio persistence, or accepted art/audio/validator changes.
